summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited, a foreign private issuer, reporting the resolutions passed at its 150th Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on June 24, 2026. The filing covers routine items: approval of the business report and financial statements, appropriation of surplus (including a year-end dividend of 100 JPY per share), election of directors (including external directors), and payment of bonuses. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is present. The filing is a routine annual meeting notice/proxy circular, so it is classified as "None."
